profile_text.body:
Arthur AI offers an AI governance platform designed to serve enterprise organizations that need to manage and oversee AI systems across their technology environments. The company describes its product as a single control plane that brings together security teams, finance teams, and AI builders to monitor, govern, and enforce policies across machine learning models, generative AI, and agentic systems. Its platform is presented as model-agnostic, framework-agnostic, and use-case-agnostic, covering AI running on endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and private data centers.

The platform's stated capabilities include discovery of AI agents across compute environments, performance monitoring, observability, guardrails, and compliance reporting, with a particular emphasis on bias mitigation and fairness metrics. One customer quoted on the company's site describes Arthur as a one-stop shop for model monitoring needs and states it will reduce their maintenance workload by 50%. Another notes that onboarding a first production model went from idea to implemented in a few hours.

The held facts confirm Arthur AI maintains a tracked product under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, consistent with the platform described on its site. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server presence are recorded for the company at this time.
